items.title: Gucci开启最高40%降价，中国市场倒逼奢侈品定价逻辑
items.summary: Chinese business outlet reports Gucci's official price cuts of 30-40% across handbags (Mercato tote, Ophidia bucket, GG Marmont bucket) and apparel in the China market, framed as a structural break from luxury's 'only rises, never falls' norm. Cites Kering CEO acknowledging some products were 'priced too high,' and notes roughly 2 million entry-level luxury buyers were lost globally in 2025 as context.

items.title: 2025年Gucci涨价了吗？已反转：2026年9月最高降40%
items.summary: Sina consumer-finance piece details specific SKU-level price cuts (Ophidia mini bucket 12,300 to 8,700 RMB; GG Marmont bucket below 10,000 RMB; Mercato small tote 25,500 to 20,000 RMB) after 12 consecutive quarters of sales decline, and frames it as Kering's deliberate strategic repricing rather than a promotion.

items.title: 古驰最高降价40%！奢侈品"只涨不降"神话破灭？
items.summary: Weibo finance/lifestyle post analyzing Gucci's up-to-40% China price cuts as breaking the sector's price-only-rises myth; frames it as a market 'stress test,' weighing bargain-hunting opportunity against risk of eroding resale value and brand prestige perception ('贵但值得' feeling). Engagement counts not visible on fetch.

items.title: 古驰大降价+新总监首秀，能重现辉煌吗？
items.summary: Weibo post weighing whether combined price cuts and Demna's design direction can restore Gucci's former standing in China; captures split consumer sentiment, some welcoming affordability, others noting exclusivity/scarcity feeling erodes once broad discounting starts. Engagement counts not visible on fetch.

items.title: 누구나 원하는 모습으로 살아가는 법, 구찌 2027 봄 여름
items.summary: Vogue Korea reviews Demna's 'The Store Show' SS27 collection in Milan, staged as an immersive Gucci boutique. Korean critic Hwang Hye-won calls it 'clear proof of hope and growth potential,' praising Demna's ability to move across many stylistic registers into a persuasive 'aristocratic handsomeness' rather than settling on one silhouette.

items.title: 구찌의 본질을 자신만의 언어로 재정의한 뎀나, 더 스토어 쇼
items.summary: GQ Korea covers Demna's SS27 'Store Show,' framing the collection around three personas (The Rebellious Aristocrat, The Snob, The Eccentric) that mix tailoring, denim, equestrian heritage codes and eveningwear. Describes Demna reworking horsebit, GG monogram and bamboo motifs through altered proportions rather than literal archive revival.

items.source: Yahoo Japan News (via Madame Figaro Japon)
items.title: デムナのヴィジョンを完全な形で表現したグッチ
items.summary: Japanese fashion critique of Gucci SS27 'Store Show' says the collection evokes the 'House of Gucci' film's 1970s-90s aesthetic reinterpreted for today, and notes Demna maintained a clear menswear/womenswear distinction even as much of fashion moves toward gender-fluid presentation, a choice the critic reads as a deliberate statement.

items.title: ケリング、26年第1四半期は6.4%減収 低迷が続く
items.summary: WWD Japan trade coverage of Kering Q1 2026 results: group revenue down 6.4 percent YoY to 3.568 billion euros, with Gucci's decline narrowing but still dragging results; CEO Luca de Meo calls Q1 stabilization 'an important step' toward recovery. Notes APAC ex-Japan store footprint (183 stores) still far larger than Western Europe (103), keeping China exposure high.

items.title: 古驰降价30%、Demna上任、关店百间！奢侈品巨头这一年
items.summary: Weibo post summarizing Gucci's 'combination punch' turnaround: roughly 30% price cuts correcting what the author calls prior 'greedflation' (signature bags from ~20,000 to ~14,000 RMB), Demna's shift from Italian elegance to deconstructed streetwear, and 100+ store closures plus new 'Made in China' sneaker manufacturing. Cautiously optimistic tone but flags diminished resale/collector appeal and polarized customer reaction.

items.title: 명품 갤러리 - 구찌 관련 스레드
items.summary: Korean community board (DCInside luxury gallery) continues to host ongoing threads discussing Gucci authentication, bag recommendations relative to competitors, and general brand-standing chatter; volume is steady but no single viral thread identified today. Included as community-channel baseline; specific per-thread engagement metrics not extractable from listing page.

items.title: 古驰保值吗？2026降价30%后哪些款式最抗跌？
items.summary: Weibo/finance-community style resale-value discussion asking whether Gucci bags still hold value after the 2026 price cuts, debating which styles remain resilient versus which lose secondhand appeal once retail price itself has dropped 30 percent. Reflects consumer anxiety about investment value, a resale-market angle distinct from pure retail pricing coverage.

items.title: 마침내 구찌에 도착한 뎀나, 도발 이후의 선택
items.summary: Elle Korea review of Demna's SS27 'Store Show' argues the collection settles into a more stable, less provocative register than his debut, balancing Gucci heritage with his own identity without tipping too far in either direction; notes the show reads like a film scene weaving familiarity and novelty, respectful of past Gucci directors while distinctly his own.
